name: The Nairobi ant smuggler (convicted; silhouette only)
depiction: Real person who pleaded guilty and was sentenced in April 2026 to one year in prison and a fine after about 2,238 live ants were found in his luggage at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. Never named on screen; a generic man's outline in a plain coat. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette: no face, no features, no likeness. Tagged ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS.
